title: refactor(meta): relocate datasource Test-connection action to backend plugin
body:
## What

Type-level metadata actions (`MetadataTypeInfo.actions`) are now sourced from the **merged** registry — declarative entries + the plugin-contributed overlay (`registerMetadataTypeActions`). The datasource **Test connection** action moves out of the open-source registry into the `datasource-admin` backend plugin (separate repo) that owns the route it calls.

## Why

The `registerMetadataTypeActions` overlay existed but was **never wired into the emit path**: `/api/v1/meta` spread the registry entry's declarative `.actions` directly, so plugin-registered actions were never surfaced. Separately, the framework hardcoded a `test_connection` button whose backend route (`POST /api/v1/datasources/:name/test`) lives only in the private `datasource-admin` plugin — so the open example emitted a button that 404'd.

## Changes

- **`objectql/protocol.ts`** — `getMetaTypes()` sources `actions` from `getMetadataTypeActions(type)` (declarative + overlay, deduped by name) in both the registry-backed and runtime-registered branches. Key omitted when empty (preserves prior response shape).
- **`spec/metadata-plugin.zod.ts`** — drop the hardcoded datasource `test_connection` action; document that it's now plugin-contributed.
- **Tests** — `metadata-type-actions.test.ts` + `metadata-service.test.ts` updated to the new contract: datasource has no declarative action; actions surface only after a plugin registers them.

## Result

The button is emitted **iff** the backend plugin that serves it is installed. Open example (no plugin) → datasource emits no actions → no 404-ing button. A cloud host with `datasource-admin` installed → button appears AND the route exists.

> Companion PR in the `cloud` repo registers the action from the plugin's `init()`.

## Verification

- `@objectstack/spec` build ✓ + full suite 6605 passed ✓
- `@objectstack/metadata` 241 passed ✓ · `@objectstack/objectql` build ✓
- E2E: open example backend restarted → `/api/v1/meta` datasource entry emits **no** `actions` key.
